name: Rejekovir
description: A broad-spectrum immunomodulator and SNT-stabilizing compound designed to interrupt acute augment rejection cycles — the process by which a host body's immune system begins attacking its own chrome interfaces, SNT bridges, and cybernetic implants. Rejekovir suppresses the specific immune pathways responsible for chrome rejection while simultaneously releasing SNT-binding proteins that reinforce the organic-synthetic interface. It is one of the most genuinely life-saving drugs in GLMZ — rejection kills, and it kills badly.
effects: Halts active augment rejection within 60-90 minutes
Stabilizes SNT interface layers under immune attack
Provides 72-96 hours of rejection suppression to allow proper medical treatment
Reverses early-stage interface necrosis if administered promptly
side_effects: Broad immune suppression creates infection vulnerability during treatment window
Nausea, fatigue, fever as rejection cycle is interrupted
Does not address root cause — rejection will resume without follow-up treatment
Rare anaphylactic response in patients with specific SNT genotypes
Overuse leads to immunological dependency — body stops managing chrome tolerance independently
cultural_context: Rejekovir is where GLMZ's class divide becomes lethal. In Tier 3-5, it's a covered medication — you go to a clinic, you get treated, you live. In Tier 1-2, the street price of a single dose is a week's wages, and rejection is a death sentence for those who can't afford treatment or access to Lazarus-licensed clinics. There's a thriving black market in stolen and counterfeit Rejekovir on the Shelf. Some batches are diluted to the point of uselessness. People die of rejection not because the drug doesn't exist, but because they can't afford it.
story_hooks: A Shelf medic has been synthesizing a generic Rejekovir analog — effective, cheap, and completely illegal under Lazarus's patent protections. Lazarus has sent someone to shut the operation down, and the medic's patients will die without it.

A Tier 4 executive is experiencing rejection of a classified military-grade augment — they can't go to official medical channels without revealing the illegal implant, so they need someone to source Rejekovir and administer it quietly
A bad batch of counterfeit Rejekovir has hit the Shelf, and people are dying — the rejection continues even after treatment, and the source needs to be traced before the next wave of casualties
